card.name: Punctuation after section headings and regex
card.fires_on: Punctuation marks such as a closing parenthesis, bullet or colon right after a period or section heading in drug labels, and the '.*' in a file-path regex.

modes.label: Regex wildcard
modes.description: The '.*' wildcard inside a file-path pattern in a command listing.

modes.label: Closing mark after heading
modes.description: A parenthesis or bullet that follows a period after an uppercase label or section heading in a label.
modes.example: ICATIONS .<<)>> Fluconazole is a moderate CYP

card.plain: It fires on stray punctuation that closes a heading or cross-reference in a label, and on a wildcard in a file path.
